caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass or crystal vessel situated in the center of an off-white or beige background. The vessel has a hexagonal shape and stands on a round, slightly raised base. Each of the six vertical faces is decorated with an engraved or etched floral or starburst pattern, featuring multiple pointed petals that have subtle accents of yellow and green. The body of the vessel features beveled edges and angled surfaces, giving it a faceted appearance. Light gray and blue hues are used to indicate the transparency and reflective qualities of the glass, with darker outlines emphasizing the structure and design details. The vessel appears empty, and there is no discernible content or additional objects in the composition. The artist's signature, "J. Petry," is located to the right of the base of the object.
title: Spoon Holder
